sorties.name: Patrol the walls
sorties.text: A night on the walls and the ditch beyond them, where things come up out of the dark to test the gate.

sorties.name: Hunt the marsh
sorties.text: Out into the reeds after whatever has been taking the goats.

sorties.name: Escort a caravan
sorties.text: Walk a merchant's wagons to the next town and back, and see that they get there.

sorties.name: Dig the old mine
sorties.text: Down into the workings under the hill, where the last crew stopped coming up.
